{{nihongo|'''Mishima Shrine (Minamiizu )'''|三島神社 (南伊豆町入間)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Mishima Shrine''' (???????) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Iruma, {{ill|Minamiizu|Q1203741|qid=Q1203741}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Shizuoka|Q961511|qid=Q961511}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4401116 Mishima Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefecture Shrine Office</ref>.

=== Overview ===
It is located on the northern mountain foothills of the Iruma district in southwestern Minamiizu.

Its founding is unknown, but it is a candidate shrine for the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} "Hotsusawake-no-Mikoto Shrine" (???(?)?????????), and an ancient shrine also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no kuni jinjaich?|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "J?shi-i no J? Otsusawake no My?jin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/misima2_title.htm Mishima Shrine] - Genmatsushi</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140137-02.html Mishima Shrine] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.
